assertions.assertion: The appeal is for a CO-97 denial
Cornerstone United determined the service was bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
The clinical indication note documents intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The submitted diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, and R42
The study was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances for further evaluation
